quote: it always uses the light theme

comments.text: Should someone in the dark theme get a dark PDF?
comments.author: user

comments.text: I kept light only. Most exported PDFs get printed, and a dark page uses a lot of ink. A dark option can come later if people ask for it.
comments.author: claude-code

comments.text: What happens to a screenshot taller than one page?
comments.author: user

comments.text: It splits across pages at the page height. I added that to the Approach.
